description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerRepository class which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and queries related to Customer entities in a customer management system.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICustomerRepository that provides database access methods for Customer entities, including retrieval, paging, add, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetPagedAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of customers with optional search filtering, returning total count and items.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new Customer entity to the database asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing Customer entity in the database asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Removes a Customer entity from the database asynchronously.
